rationale: The workflow already implements the evidence-supported optimizations that fit it. Dependency downloads are cached via ruby/setup-ruby@v1 with bundler-cache: true (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE; contraindication 'An equivalent cache already exists' applies, so adding a separate actions/cache step would be redundant). Stale run cancellation is already configured via concurrency with cancel-in-progress: true (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE). Push triggers are already path-filtered to docs/** and firmware/manifest.json (P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER). No matrix exists to tune fail-fast, no scheduled workflows exist to pause or suppress, no Bazel build exists to tune, and there is no completed CI history to derive a safe custom timeout (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT precondition 'Representative successful-duration history exists' is unmet; repository context shows no completed runs). Adding arbitrary timeouts or redundant cache steps risks interrupting valid builds or creating cache conflicts without measured benefit.
